Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, street-facing, fov 76
- residential road, 2-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks present, curbs present
- driveways: corner entrance apron; parking: concrete apron in front of the bays
- small office with plate glass building at corner of the lot, 1 story, brick veneer, plate glass, flat parapet roof, 20 feet from road setback
- service bay row under one continuous roof building at rear of the lot, 1 story, concrete block, corrugated metal, flat roof, 40 feet from road setback
- utilities: overhead power lines, utility pole at the corner
- landscape: narrow grass strip along the road, gravel edge along the apron
- immutable elements: painted sign band across the parapet, corner lot at the intersection, concrete apron in front of the service bays
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2005
Post-9/11 era. An auto repair shop in 2005 — a check-engine scanner plugged into a customer's dashboard, a wall of aftermarket wheels, and a printed vinyl banner where hand-painted lettering used to be.

PERIOD DETAILS
- a printed banner advertising tire brands and a '$24.95 OIL CHANGE' promo, replacing the old painted sign
- office with plate glass window, a flat monitor visible on the counter
- a small waiting area with a TV mounted in the corner of the office
- window signs: 'ALIGNMENT $49.95', 'CHECK ENGINE LIGHT $59.95'
- a barcode scanner at the parts counter
- a stack of take-off wheels behind the building
Typography: clean sans-serif, polished brand identities.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 3 people TOTAL: 1 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 1 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 1 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a customer pointing at a check-engine code printout
- the owner ringing up a repair at a barcode register
- a man in cargo shorts talking on a flip phone
Clothing: men in graphic tees, baggy jeans; women in velour tracksuits, layered tank tops. Fashion palette: denim, pink, white. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 2 period vehicles, all different:
- 2001-2005 Honda Civic — rounded compact, very common — silver
- 2002-2007 Jeep Liberty — round-headlight compact SUV — gray
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 2005.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: all parked on the LEFT side of the street with gaps between them. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: worn and faded, well past their last repainting
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, cable and fiber lines on poles appearing

DECAY
- a hand-lettered service sign taped inside the office glass
- one service bay door rolled down while the other stays open
Wear is surfaces only — road, curbs, footprints, camera unchanged.
TREES
- maple tree at street corner: clearly smaller than in the source — about 60% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- elm tree at side yard: clearly smaller than in the source — about 40% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — early digital camera or Kodak/Fuji consumer film look.
Color: neutral tones. Grain: low grain, early digital noise in shadows.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 2001-2005 Honda Civic — rounded compact, very common
